Here, the code inside the <style> tag is a CSS code. You don't need to understand it at the moment. Just focus on the output.
As you can see, we are able to apply background colors to the entire group. When you start using CSS, you will learn more about <div>.

items: <div> is a block-level element. Meaning it takes the full width available.
We use <div> to group multiple HTML elements.
The reason we group elements is to make it easier to add styles and create layouts.
